key.name: panel-metric
key.summary: Metric shown in the top bar
key.description: Which limit the top bar pie stands for.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Shows the value as a number next to the pie.

key.name: show-countdown
key.summary: Show the time left before the reset
key.description: Shows the time left in the 5-hour window next to the pie.

key.name: claude-path
key.description: Leave empty to detect it automatically.

key.name: notify-enabled
key.summary: Notify when a limit passes a threshold
key.description: Sends a notification once per window for each threshold crossed.

key.name: notify-threshold-low
key.description: Percentage of a limit at which the first notification is sent.

key.name: notify-threshold-high
key.description: Percentage of a limit at which the second notification is sent.
